"""Launch the admitted original checkpoint recovery;never restart full training."""
import os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert not (root/'launch-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'controller.claim').exists()
assert read(root/'recovery-CPU-readiness-v1.json')['exact_original_control_rows']==915
assert read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json')['returncode']==0
with (root/'controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-P',plan['runner']['path'],'controller',str(root/'plan-v1.json')],cwd=repo,
  env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'),
  stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'launch-v1.json',{'status':'original750-checkpoint-recovery-controller-launched','owner':owner,'plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),
 'adoption':ref(root/'resume-adoption-v1.json'),'CPU_readiness':ref(root/'recovery-CPU-readiness-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(owner,flush=True)
